bio.text: Herb Conaway represents New Jersey's 3rd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives.

A lifelong Burlington County resident, he earned an undergraduate degree from Princeton University, a medical degree from Jefferson Medical College, and a law degree from Rutgers Law School in Camden.
He served in the U.S. Air Force, reaching the rank of Captain in the Medical Corps, before practicing internal medicine and teaching as a clinical professor.
He served 25 years in the New Jersey Assembly representing the 7th Legislative District, where he chaired the Health Committee.
